$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (the item's link or page, the separator, or #target for whole trails) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Items are compared on their own link or page element (the manifest's target).

Slot.$why: The trail's width is the sum of its labels, which Figma snaps to whole pixels (see the manifest); its height is 20 px in Figma with the 24 px Ellipsis overflowing it, while the list grows to 24 px. Items are centred on the same line either way; the gap is compared.
